ja.title: in-context learningは設計の計算量を下げるか。Evo 2の「81時間対900時間」を通過率と償却で分解する
ja.summary: Evo 2のin-context learningの計算時間の比較を、通過率と固定費の償却に分けて読み直した。CRISPR-Casでは節約は約900個の通過した設計までで、ファージでは通過率の16.7倍の差が主因だった。
ja.seo_description: Evo 2のin-context learningの計算時間（81時間対約900時間、2.1対約200 GPU時間）を、サンプルあたりの通過率と微調整の固定費の償却で分解し、損益分岐を計算した。
ja.seo_title: Evo 2のICLの計算量を分解する

en.title: Does in-context learning lower the compute of design? Decomposing Evo 2's "81 hours versus 900 hours" into yield and amortization
en.summary: The reported compute comparison for Evo 2 in-context learning was reread as pass rate and amortization of a fixed cost. For CRISPR-Cas the saving lasts only up to about 900 passing designs; for phage a 16.7-fold difference in pass rate is the main source.
en.seo_description: The reported compute times for Evo 2 in-context learning (81 versus about 900 hours; 2.1 versus about 200 GPU hours) were decomposed into per-sample pass rate and amortization of the fine-tuning cost, and break-even points were computed.
